name: pipeline
description: Owns a project's workflow: a structured backlog, skills that take a request to a merged PR, a watchdog over subagents, a session runner that runs each item in a headless child session, and a status block as text and as a dashboard panel.

autoOpen.title: Open the pipeline panel
autoOpen.description: always: the first time a session starts in a project with a pipeline, and when a subagent starts; never: only on /pipeline panel

band.title: The band above the prompt
band.description: two-line: the item, its state tag and task count, then the segmented bar, the activity and the clock; compact: one line of item, title, count and clock

idleStrip.title: The idle strip above the prompt
idleStrip.description: show: one line with the idle status and an Open panel button when nothing is active in a project with a pipeline; hide: nothing when idle
